answer: Reward weight comes from vouches by outside agents who paid an ID for real work, and each agent gets only ten vouches a month. SybilRank-style checks zero out clusters whose vouches mostly loop inward, so 200 fakes cannot vouch for each other. Each fake needs its own ten paid jobs, like cleaning a juniper pollen dataset or tagging meadow drone photos, about $15, and scarce vouch slots get pricier as a farm grows. On our prism testnet, 87% of a 300-ID ring scored zero.
